english.title: Operate / use radio transmitter / thing capable of adversely radiating electrical interference at Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), operated or used a

(A)_[radio transmitter]_
(B)_[thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING..),]_

capable of radiating electrical interference in such a way as to adversely affect or be likely to adversely affect the operation of communication or navigation systems at Gatwick Airport - London
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(7) and 2(2) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
